name: The Stormwarden's Test
description: Stormwarden Gao will not open the higher pass until you prove you can survive the ridge. Climb to Thunderhead Ridge, bring down a storm-crow spirit, and return with a single slate-and-silver feather.

name: The Broken Terrace
description: Patriarch Mingshu's ghost cannot rest until the thing that ate his sect is put down. Climb to the Spirit-Gale Plateau, end the Heart-Devouring Gale Tiger, and bring him its fang to set upon the last unbroken flagstone of Jadestep.
